boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named, documented destinations on practical off-campus corridors around Messiah University.

cards.title: West Grantham Road — TJ Rockwell's
cards.subtitle: West Grantham Road corridor
cards.notes: Use the West Grantham Road address to plan a seated meal; check the restaurant’s location page before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A documented restaurant stop on West Grantham Road.
cards.evidence_claim: TJ Rockwell’s lists its Mechanicsburg location at 896 West Grantham Road.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant service; current hours are listed by the business.

cards.title: Gettysburg Pike — The Cracked Pot
cards.subtitle: Gettysburg Pike corridor
cards.notes: Meet at the Mechanicsburg coffee-shop location and review its posted hours before making the short off-campus trip.
cards.short_summary: A nonprofit coffee shop on Gettysburg Pike.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cracked Pot identifies its Mechanicsburg location as 130 Gettysburg Pike and describes itself as a nonprofit coffee shop.
cards.access_notes: Food and drinks are sold; the business posts current hours.

cards.title: Mount Allen Drive — Messiah Village
cards.subtitle: Mount Allen Drive corridor
cards.notes: Use the listed address to find Messiah Village and consult its contact page for the appropriate public-facing service.
cards.short_summary: A named Messiah Lifeways campus on Mount Allen Drive.
cards.evidence_claim: Messiah Lifeways lists Messiah Village at 100 Mt. Allen Drive in Mechanicsburg and identifies dining and lifelong learning among its enrichment services.
cards.access_notes: Some amenities and programs may have separate access requirements; contact Messiah Lifeways first.

cards.title: East Mount Airy Road — Mt. Airy Orchards
cards.subtitle: East Mount Airy Road corridor
cards.notes: Check the orchard’s seasonal information, then choose the farm store or a currently offered pick-your-own activity.
cards.short_summary: An orchard and farm store on East Mount Airy Road.
cards.evidence_claim: Mt. Airy Orchards describes itself as a Dillsburg farm and agri-tourism destination and lists 522 East Mount Airy Road.
cards.access_notes: Farm store and activities are seasonal; confirm availability and pricing with the orchard.

cards.title: South Middlesex Road — Carlisle Sports Emporium
cards.subtitle: South Middlesex Road corridor
cards.notes: Choose an activity and confirm operating hours before heading to the South Middlesex Road entertainment venue.
cards.short_summary: A year-round activity venue on South Middlesex Road.
cards.evidence_claim: Carlisle Sports Emporium lists 29 South Middlesex Road and states that it is open year-round.
cards.access_notes: Activities require admission or purchases; verify current hours and activity availability.

cards.title: Carlisle Pike — Urban Churn
cards.subtitle: Carlisle Pike corridor
cards.notes: Use the Carlisle Pike shop listing to check the live flavor menu and current hours before making an ice-cream stop.
cards.short_summary: A craft-creamery location on Carlisle Pike.
cards.evidence_claim: Urban Churn lists a Carlisle Pike shop at 6391 Carlisle Pike in Mechanicsburg and provides a flavor-menu link.
cards.access_notes: Ice cream is sold; business-posted hours vary by day.

cards.title: Carlisle Pike — Crumbl Cookies
cards.subtitle: Carlisle Pike corridor
cards.notes: Confirm the Mechanicsburg store listing, then use the address for a cookie pickup rather than relying on a search listing.
cards.short_summary: A cookie-shop location on Carlisle Pike.
cards.evidence_claim: Crumbl’s Pennsylvania store page lists its Mechanicsburg store at 6416 Carlisle Pike, Suite 1400.
cards.access_notes: Cookies require purchase; check the official store page for current details.

cards.title: Carlisle Pike — Chick-fil-A
cards.subtitle: Carlisle Pike corridor
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s own page to confirm service options and plan a meal on a day it is open.
cards.short_summary: A documented quick-service restaurant on Carlisle Pike.
cards.evidence_claim: Chick-fil-A lists its Mechanicsburg restaurant at 6416 Carlisle Pike, Suite 3500, with dine-in and carry-out service.
cards.access_notes: The restaurant is closed Sundays; food requires purchase.

cards.title: Carlisle Pike — Target
cards.subtitle: Carlisle Pike corridor
cards.notes: Use the official store page to locate the store and check which in-store services are available for your errand.
cards.short_summary: A retail stop with listed in-store services on Carlisle Pike.
cards.evidence_claim: Target lists its Mechanicsburg store at 6416 Carlisle Pike and identifies a Starbucks Café and CVS pharmacy among in-store services.
cards.access_notes: Retail items and café purchases cost money; check the store page for current service hours.

cards.title: Carlisle Pike — Hobby Lobby
cards.subtitle: Carlisle Pike corridor
cards.notes: Use the store locator for the exact suite and browse supplies only during the business’s currently posted store hours.
cards.short_summary: An arts-and-crafts retail stop on Carlisle Pike.
cards.evidence_claim: Hobby Lobby lists its Mechanicsburg store at 5600 Carlisle Pike, Suite 700, and describes arts, craft, and DIY supplies.
cards.access_notes: Merchandise requires purchase; the official page posts store hours.
